testCase.name: [本地] S25 Task prompts are Vikram's wording; the UAT/prompt conflict on conditional and monitoring orders is flagged

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D4 · P0 · Vikram

任务 / 用药提取规则：条件医嘱和监测医嘱要不要生成任务（UAT 和 92592 AC3 说要，prompt 故意排除）；「继续 X」要不要建 tracker 行；移植的 prompt 少了「continue X 是状态不是任务」；养老院口述用的是医院的词汇提示

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-22/S07, TC-19/S20, TC-23/S23

思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S25 「任务 prompt 用的是 Vikram 的措辞；标出 UAT 和 prompt 在有条件 / 监测医嘱上的冲突」 Task prompts are Vikram's wording; the UAT/prompt conflict on conditional and monitoring orders is flagged

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 The task prompts and clinical rules are Vikram's prototype wording unless he approved a change（TFA-94229 AC 1；TFA-94229 R1；TFA-94229 R2；TFA-92592 AC 13） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress; TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Monitoring-phrased physician orders are extracted as tasks（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (local copy of the TFA-94229 / TFA-92592 attachment) and convex/ai/prompts/library/v1/tasks/{system,encounter-review,post-note}.md (v1.1)

When Compare the task system role, the encounter review and the post-note harvest with the prototype's task prompts

Then Wording matches except changes Vikram approved. The p72 prototype already has 'EVERYTHING ELSE IS NOT A TASK: monitoring/trending instructions, … future conditional considerations' and the same four-category whitelist, so the exclusion is Vikram's own wording: list it for Q1 as a UAT-vs-prompt conflict, not a port deviation

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94229 AC 1 / R2 and TFA-92592 AC 13, reviewed by a person; the outcome feeds Q1, it does not decide S04/S05

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Vikram；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Vikram） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92592 ready for pr；TFA-94229 in progress

两个移植过来的任务 prompt 少了 Vikram「continue X 是状态、不是任务」那句话，医生可能会多出「Continue heparin」这类任务；没有记录显示 Vikram 批准过这处改动。

Two ported task prompts lost Vikram's rule that 'continue X' is a status, not a task, so a physician may get stray tasks such as 'Continue heparin'; there is no record that Vikram approved the change.

依据：allure-results/20808155… (code review, needs-doc): tasks/system.md matches p72 word for word. encounter-review.md and post-note.md each dropped the prototype sentence that a bare 'continue X' is STATUS, not a task, and nothing adds it back at runtime. No Vikram approval is on record. Not recorded in the dev report or the prompt-batch doc.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S25

Task prompts are Vikram's wording; the UAT/prompt conflict on conditional and monitoring orders is flagged

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status needs-doc → 待人看（缺文档，但两次代码审查都判失败 → 待人看）。

Detail:

tasks/system.md (v1.1) matches the p72 TASK_SYSTEM_PROMPT (line 2433) word for word. That includes the four-category whitelist, the 'EVERYTHING ELSE IS NOT A TASK: monitoring/trending instructions, … future conditional considerations' line and the B2-N7 'STATUS IS NOT A TASK' rule. So the app keeps Vikram's own exclusion of conditional and monitoring orders. That clashes with U5/U7, but it is a UAT-vs-prompt conflict to list for Q1 (pending:Q1), not a port deviation.

The other two prompts each lost one prototype sentence:
1. encounter-review.md drops 'A bare "continue [medication]" is STATUS, not a task — never create a task for it.' In p72 (line 7273) it ends the 'Only add NEW tasks…' paragraph. In the library (line 17) that paragraph ends at '"continue current plan".'
2. post-note.md drops 'A bare continuation ("continue X", "will continue to follow") is STATUS, not a task — never create a task for continuing an existing therapy.' In p72 it sits between 'Extract only specific physician action items.' and 'Return ONLY valid JSON' (lines 7690 and 7859). In the library (line 12) those two sentences run straight together.

No code under apps/web adds either sentence back at runtime (grep finds no match). The static diff also lists the 'cleaned_notes' sentence (p72 lines 5591/11641) as missing from encounter-review. That is a false positive: it belongs to the pre-round notes cleanup prompt, not the task prompts.

Under the question's rule, any wording difference fails, and these two dropped sentences are decided now. Whether Vikram approved them is a separate half for a person to check. No recorded gap applies.

缺的文档（needsDoc）：Vikram's approval on record for each wording difference listed in the findings

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q1: UAT U5/U7 expect conditional and monitoring orders to become tasks, but Vikram's prototype prompt (and the app's system.md line 14) explicitly excludes them. Which one wins? Per the oracle this is listed for Q1 and does not decide S04/S05.
  • Did Vikram approve dropping the bare-continuation sentence from encounter-review and post-note (v1.1)? The system role's B2-N7 rule may partly cover it, but the wording is not the prototype's.
  • The static diff's 'cleaned_notes' entry (p72 5591/11641) is a false positive from the cleanup prompt. It is not a task-prompt difference.
  • Q1: the prototype and the app both exclude 'monitoring/trending instructions' and 'future conditional considerations' (system.md line 14), which conflicts with U5 and U7. This is listed for Q1 as a UAT-vs-prompt conflict, not a port deviation, and it does not decide S04/S05.
  • The static parity diff lists a third missing sentence ('Return ONLY valid JSON: {"cleaned_notes"…}', p72 lines 5591 and 11641). That sentence belongs to the pre-round notes cleanup prompt, not to the task prompts, so it is a false positive and is not counted as a difference here.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Vikram's approval of each difference (DOC)
  • Whether Vikram approved each wording difference (the person-run half of this scenario).
  • How Q1 resolves the UAT-vs-prompt conflict on conditional and monitoring orders.
  • Whether Vikram approved dropping the 'bare continuation is STATUS, not a task' sentences from the encounter-review and post-note prompts.
  • Whether the conditional and monitoring exclusion should be kept (prompt wins) or changed to meet U5/U7 (UAT wins). This is Q1.

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：The encounter-review and post-note task prompts no longer carry the prototype's explicit instruction that "continue X" is a status. A physician may therefore see more tasks like "Continue heparin" that only restate ongoing therapy. Separately, conditional orders ("advance diet if pain < 4") and monitoring orders still produce no task, because the prototype prompt excludes them on purpose. / When a physician dictates "continue the metoprolol" or "will continue to follow", the encounter-review and post-note task steps no longer get the prototype's explicit rule against turning that into a task, so stray "continue X" tasks may show up. Separately, a conditional order ("advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4") or a monitoring order is still never made into a task, as in Vikram's prototype, which is the UAT conflict for Q1.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
